description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Lockheed Martin is seeking an early-career Software Engineer to support mission-focused software development. The role involves designing, developing, documenting, testing, debugging, and troubleshooting software while applying established development standards, processes, and tools throughout the software development life cycle.
Software developer building, testing, debugging, and documenting business applications under development standards

Responsibilities:
• Plans, conducts, and coordinates software development activities
• Designs, develops, documents, tests, and debugs software that contains logical and mathematical solutions to business/mission problems or questions in computer language for solutions by means of data processing equipment
• Applies the appropriate standards, processes, procedures, and tools throughout the development life cycle
• Applies knowledge of computer hardware and software, subject matter to be programmed in business/mission applications, information processing techniques used, and information gathered from system users to develop software
• Corrects program errors, prepares operating instructions, compiles documentation of program development, and analyzes system capabilities to resolve questions of program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques, and controls
• Ensures software standards are met

Requirements:
• Bachelor of Science in Computer Science or Computer Engineering
• Languages: C++, Python
• Framework & Tools: Linux
• Docker, Podman or container-based architectures
• Gitlab
• Must be a US Citizen
• This position will require a government security clearance
• This position is located at a facility that requires special access

Preferred:
• QT Framework experience
• Common Object Request Broker Architecture (CORBA)
• Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment Pipelines (CI/CD)
• Window Subsystem for Linux (WSL)
• Experience using Virtual Machines (VMs)
• Experience using Kubernetes
• Embedded Software and Operator Graphical User Interface (Gui's)
• Signal Processing of Digital, Serial and Ethernet data
• Machine Learning(ML)/Artificial Intelligence(AI) : PyTorch, TensorFlow, LLMs, Deep Learning
• Familiar with Computer components
